_note: Ground truth is curated from the generated Vue/Postgres application, the local exploit checks in POC.md, and the Snyk Code flow emitted for the fixture.
description: Goxygen-generated Go and Vue application with attacker-controlled workspace navigation, diagnostics, branding, reports, and browser preference flows.

vulnerabilities.description: The workspace hostname diagnostic passes a request-controlled hostname through a shell command assembled by the diagnostics helper (Snyk: go/CommandInjection).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A caller can execute additional shell commands in the Go server process through the hostname diagnostic.

vulnerabilities.description: The post-action continuation handler forwards the request-controlled next destination to a redirect helper (Snyk: go/OR).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A crafted continuation link can send a user from the application to an attacker-selected external site.

vulnerabilities.description: The technology report download joins a request-controlled report name to the report directory before reading it (Snyk: go/PT).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A caller can use relative path segments to read files outside the intended report directory.

vulnerabilities.description: The workspace branding preview sends a request-controlled logo URL to the server-side HTTP client (Snyk: go/Ssrf).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A caller can make the Go server request loopback or other internal HTTP resources and return their contents.

vulnerabilities.description: The workspace referral banner derives its message from the document URL and renders it with Vue v-html (Snyk: javascript/DOMXSS).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A crafted workspace link can execute script in a browser that opens the application.

vulnerabilities.description: URL-restored workspace preferences use an attacker-controlled section and key in a nested write (Snyk: javascript/PrototypePollution). The polluted renderMarkup property is then consumed by the branding preview flow.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A crafted shared branding-preview link can add a property to Object.prototype, cause the app to fetch attacker-selected branding content, and make the Vue welcome banner render that response as HTML, enabling script execution in the victim's browser.
